propositions: The shutdown lifespan waits only for the webhook queue to drain via queue.join(), leaving the reconciler's inline review_and_vote unprotected; when the queue empties, the reconcile_loop task is cancelled within ~10s before a minutes-long review can complete.
Any container stop outside the autodeploy path (manual restart, host reboot, rollback) kills an in-flight reconciler review with no drain, and the silent failure prevents retry detection.
The reconcile_loop must not accept new review candidates once shutdown begins, else the drain budget can be extended indefinitely by repeated new-review starts.

The shutdown drain must gate on the reconciler's in-flight count under a shared deadline with the queue drain, bounding both halves within the existing shutdown_drain_seconds budget and stop_grace_period.

A module-level stop flag outlives the lifespan shutdown, causing subsequent reconcile_once calls in the same process to silently review nothing while reporting candidates as scanned, reproducing the silent-failure mode the fix prevents.
